_comment: Independent public-input witness for win/tty/topl.c tty_yn_function() lines 435-442 with msg_window:combination: a Ranger opens the #pray confirmation and presses ^P twice inside it. Each one runs tty_doprev_message() with inread cleared, then tty_clear_nhwindow(WIN_MESSAGE), cw->maxcol = cw->maxrow and addtopl(prompt). After n, three ^P at the command level show the answered prompt, the newest stored message and then the history window, as they do when no recall preceded them.
